name: – Christian Ehler – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the assessment of the implementation of Horizon Europe in view of its interim evaluation and recommendations for the 10th Research Framework Programme
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on Horizon Europe, the EU's research funding programme, ahead of its interim review. It says the programme is too complex and bureaucratic, that success rates are too low, and that Europe risks falling behind the United States and China. It asks for a bigger, simpler successor programme from 2028, with more money, less paperwork and more say for scientists. These are recommendations only; they do not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only recommends; the Commission decides on future funding proposals.
- **Who it affects:** Researchers, small businesses and universities applying for EU research money.
- **What happens next:** The Commission will consider these views when drafting the next research programme.
